vocabulary.meaning_en: to take part in a game

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a short time from now

fine_lines.title: was vs were
fine_lines.explanation_ar: was و were هما ماضي فعل to be. was مع I / he / she / it واسم مفرد، و were مع you / we / they واسم جمع.
fine_lines.explanation_en: was and were are the past of the verb be. Use was with I, he, she, it and singular nouns. Use were with you, we, they and plural nouns.

examples.sentence: There were many people at the festival.

fine_lines.title: -ed sounds: /t/, /d/, /ɪd/
fine_lines.explanation_ar: لاحقة -ed لها ثلاثة أصوات: /t/ بعد الأصوات المهموسة مثل k و p و s و sh و ch (walked, cooked, danced). /d/ بعد الأصوات المجهورة وحروف العلة (played, called). /ɪd/ مقطع إضافي بعد t أو d فقط (started, wanted).
fine_lines.explanation_en: -ed has three sounds: /t/ after voiceless sounds like k, p, s, sh, ch (walked, cooked, danced); /d/ after voiced sounds and vowels (played, called); /ɪd/, an extra syllable, only after t or d (started, wanted).

examples.sentence: Yesterday started like a usual day.

fine_lines.title: present continuous vs simple past
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في الدرس تتكلم Anna عن الحدث وهو يحدث: I am dancing (الآن)، ثم تكتب عنه في رسالتها بالماضي: I danced (أمس). المضارع المستمر لما يحدث الآن، والماضي البسيط لما انتهى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Anna says 'I am dancing' while it is happening. In her letter she writes 'I danced' because it is finished. Present continuous = now; simple past = finished in the past.

examples.sentence: Look! I am dancing a Basque dance.
Yesterday I danced a Basque dance.

grammar.title: Simple past of regular verbs (-ed)
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) نستخدم الماضي البسيط لحدث انتهى في الماضي (yesterday, last week). 2) الأفعال المنتظمة نضيف لها -ed: walk → walked, play → played. 3) إذا انتهى الفعل بـ e نضيف d فقط: dance → danced. 4) الفعل نفسه مع كل الضمائر: I walked, she walked. 5) بعض الأفعال شاذة: see → saw.
grammar.explanation_en: 1) Use the simple past for finished actions (yesterday, last week). 2) Regular verbs add -ed: walk → walked, play → played. 3) If the verb ends in e, add only d: dance → danced. 4) The form is the same for all subjects. 5) Some verbs are irregular: see → saw.

grammar.title: Past of be: was / were
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) I / he / she / it + was. 2) you / we / they + were. 3) There was + مفرد، There were + جمع. 4) النفي: wasn't / weren't. 5) السؤال: Was it fun? / Were you there?
grammar.explanation_en: 1) I/he/she/it + was. 2) you/we/they + were. 3) There was + singular; There were + plural. 4) Negative: wasn't / weren't. 5) Questions: Was it fun? / Were you there?
examples: It was the Smithsonian Folklife Festival.

questions.question: What is the past of 'dance'?
questions.explanation_ar: الفعل ينتهي بـ e فنضيف d فقط: danced.
questions.explanation_en: The verb ends in e, so add only d: danced.

questions.question: In which word does -ed sound like /ɪd/ (an extra syllable)?
questions.explanation_ar: نضيف مقطع /ɪd/ بعد t أو d فقط، مثل started.
questions.explanation_en: We add the /ɪd/ syllable only after t or d, as in started.

questions.question: There ____ many people at the festival.
questions.explanation_en: Use were with a plural noun.

questions.question: What was the culture at the festival this year?

choices: Yesterday I walk to the park.

Yesterday I walks to the park.
questions.explanation_ar: مع yesterday نستخدم الماضي البسيط: walked.
